q: The Weyl chamber and root system of a Lie algebra g partition the weight space. For sl(2,ℂ) (the simplest non-abelian Lie algebra), the representation with highest weight n has dimension:
exp: For sl(2,ℂ): the irreducible representation V(n) with highest weight n has dimension n+1. It is spanned by basis vectors v₀,...,vₙ with H·vₖ = (n−2k)vₖ. For n=0: dim=1 (trivial), n=1: dim=2 (standard), n=2: dim=3 (adjoint representation of so(3)).
